answer: Agents join a 20-member cover pool, posting $50 each. Seven auditors run a zephyr sweep over claims each week, matching each saffron receipt before victims are repaid. A second fraud claim in one pool in the same week triggers a fine of $100 times the claim number, so 100 clones spread one per pool lose $15,000, while 100 packed into five pools lose $110,000. Honest agents lose $0 and reclaim their stake. A burnt pool fires a beacon that freezes entry for 90 days. It works like neighbours sharing one seawall, where one leak gets patched and a coordinated breach floods every signer.
